section.content: 本实用新型提供一种生物基因提取仪器，涉及基因提取技术领域，包括工作台，所述工作台上表面开设有槽口，所述槽口内表面固定连接有放置板，所述放置板上表面设置有离心机，所述槽口内表面设置有双向丝杆，所述双向丝杆右端面与槽口内表面滑动贯穿，所述双向丝杆右端面固定连接有转盘，所述双向丝杆外表面对称螺纹连接有滑动座。本实用新型中，通过双向丝杆、滑动座、夹板和橡胶垫的配合设置，可以根据离心机的大小进行调整位置并进行固定，通过阻尼器与弹簧的配合设置，离心机产生的振动会由夹板传导到阻尼器位置，通过阻尼器与弹簧的配合工作可以起到缓冲减震的作用，提高装置整体的稳定性。

The utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument relates to gene extraction technical field, comprises a workbench, the notch has been seted up to the workstation upper surface, fixed surface is connected with places the board in the notch, it is provided with centrifuge to place the board upper surface, the notch internal surface is provided with two-way lead screw, two-way lead screw right-hand member face slides with the notch internal surface and runs through, two-way lead screw right-hand member face fixedly connected with carousel, two-way lead screw surface symmetry threaded connection has the sliding seat. The utility model discloses in, through the cooperation setting of two-way lead screw, sliding seat, splint and rubber pad, can adjust the position and fix according to centrifuge's size, through the cooperation setting of attenuator and spring, the vibration that centrifuge produced can be conducted the attenuator position by splint, can play the absorbing effect of buffering through the cooperation work of attenuator and spring, improves the holistic stability of device.

Biological gene extraction instrumentTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene extraction technical field especially relates to a biological gene draws instrument.

Background

The biological gene extraction instrument mainly extracts genes of organisms or plants, separation and purification work related to biomolecules is very important and indispensable in almost every laboratory, and a centrifugal machine is a main extraction mode in gene extraction.

In the prior art, for example, in chinese patent CN 211946990U, a biological gene extraction apparatus includes a workbench having a cabinet structure, a centrifuge, an oscillator, and a boiling water bath unit are correspondingly disposed on the workbench, a plurality of reaction tubes are correspondingly disposed in the centrifuge, the oscillator, and the boiling water bath unit, six robots are correspondingly disposed on the side of the workbench, and a terminal manipulator of the six robots is correspondingly connected to an extraction jig. The utility model relates to a biological gene draws instrument simple structure integrates, the operation degree of automation is high, can effectual improvement to flexibility, convenience and the work efficiency of biological gene extraction operation, especially be fit for the more sample of a quantity, for example the gene of virus draws in the blood.

In the above-mentioned patent, although this biological gene draws instrument simple structure integrates, the operation degree of automation is high, nevertheless can produce the vibration at centrifuge's operation in-process, centrifuge's vibration can drive the whole skew that produces of device, and the device is holistic stability relatively poor.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at solving the problem that the vibration of the centrifuge can drive the whole device to shift, the stability of the whole device is poor, and the biological gene extracting instrument is provided.

In order to realize the purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme: the utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument, includes the workstation, the notch has been seted up to the workstation upper surface, fixed surface is connected with places the board in the notch, it is provided with centrifuge to place the board upper surface, the notch internal surface is provided with two-way lead screw, two-way lead screw right-hand member face runs through with the notch internal surface slides, two-way lead screw right-hand member face fixedly connected with carousel, two-way lead screw surface symmetry threaded connection has a sliding seat, two a plurality of dampers of impartial fixedly connected with in the adjacent one side surface of sliding seat, it is a plurality of the damper surface all overlaps and is equipped with the spring, and is two sets of equal fixedly connected with splint between the damper terminal surface.

Preferably, the equal fixedly connected with base in workstation lower surface edge, two-way lead screw left end face is connected with notch left side internal surface rotation.

Preferably, rubber pads are adhered to the outer surfaces of the two adjacent sides of the clamping plates, and the two clamping plates are matched with the centrifuge in position.

Preferably, limiting rods are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the inner surface of the notch, and the outer surfaces of the two limiting rods are slidably connected with the inner surfaces of the two sliding seats.

Preferably, the inner surface of the notch is symmetrically provided with sliding grooves, the inner surfaces of the two sliding grooves are symmetrically and slidably connected with sliding blocks, and the two sliding blocks are fixedly connected with the two sliding seats respectively.

Preferably, the inner surface of the rotary table is in threaded connection with a threaded rod, and the right end face of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with a rotating handle.

Preferably, a plurality of positioning holes are uniformly formed in the outer surface of the right side of the workbench, and the inner surfaces of the positioning holes are in threaded connection with the outer surface of the threaded rod.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages and positive effects that,

1. the utility model discloses in, through the cooperation setting of two-way lead screw, sliding seat, splint and rubber pad, can adjust the position and fix according to centrifuge's size, through the cooperation setting of attenuator and spring, the vibration that centrifuge produced can be conducted the attenuator position by splint, can play the absorbing effect of buffering through the cooperation work of attenuator and spring, improves the holistic stability of device.

2. The utility model discloses in, hold the turning handle and can rotate the threaded rod at the carousel internal rotation, rotate the threaded rod and insert the locating hole back, through fixed spacing between threaded rod and the workstation, can prevent the carousel from taking place to rotate, avoid can leading to two-way lead screw to follow resonance rotation and lead to splint to take place not hard up problem taking place at the vibration that takes place centrifuge during operation production, promoted splint to the fixed stability of centrifuge.

Detailed Description

In order to make the above objects, features and advantages of the present invention more clearly understood, the present invention will be further described with reference to the accompanying drawings and examples. It should be noted that the embodiments and features of the embodiments of the present application may be combined with each other without conflict.

In the following description, numerous specific details are set forth in order to provide a thorough understanding of the present invention, however, the present invention may be practiced in other ways than those specifically described herein, and therefore the present invention is not limited to the limitations of the specific embodiments of the present disclosure.

Embodiment 1, as shown in fig. 1-4, the utility model provides a biological gene draws instrument, comprises a workbench 1, notch 3 has been seted up to workstation 1 upper surface, 3 internal surface fixedly connected with of notch place board 4, place board 4 upper surface and be provided with centrifuge 5, 3 internal surfaces of notch are provided with two-way lead screw 6, 6 right-hand member face of two-way lead screw slides with 3 internal surfaces of notch and runs through, 6 right-hand member face fixedly connected with carousel 8 of two-way lead screw, 6 external surface symmetric threaded connection of two-way lead screw has sliding seat 12, the impartial fixedly connected with a plurality of attenuator 13 of two adjacent one side surfaces of sliding seat 12, a plurality of attenuator 13 surfaces all overlap and are equipped with spring 14, equal fixedly connected with splint 15 between two sets of attenuator 13 terminal surfaces, the equal fixedly connected with base 2 of 1 lower surface edge department of workstation, 6 left-hand member face of two-way lead screw is connected with 3 left side internal surface rotation of notch, two adjacent one side surfaces of splint 15 all are stained with rubber pad 16, two splint 15 all cooperate with centrifuge 5 positions, 3 internal surface symmetric fixedly connected with gag lever 7, two gag lever 7 external surfaces and two internal surface sliding seat 12 internal surface sliding connection notches, 3 symmetrical sliding connection spouts 18, two sets of sliding seat sliding blocks 17.

The effect that its whole embodiment 1 reaches does, when installing centrifuge 5, place centrifuge 5 and place board 4 top, it can drive two-way lead screw 6 and rotate to hold turning handle 10 to rotate carousel 8, can drive two sliding seat 12 and carry out relative movement when two-way lead screw 6 rotates, the mobile position of sliding seat 12 has been played limiting displacement to setting up through gag lever post 7 when sliding seat 12 mobile position, can improve the stability of sliding seat 12 operation through the cooperation setting of slider 17 with spout 18, can drive splint 15 and move centrifuge 5 position and press from both sides centrifugal machine 5 tight fixed when two sliding seat 12 move to centrifuge 5 direction, can play the guard action to centrifuge 5 through the setting of rubber pad 16 when splint 15 is fixed, prevent to cause the damage to centrifuge 5, at centrifuge 5 during operation, the vibration that centrifuge 5 produced can be conducted the attenuator 13 position by splint 15, cooperation through attenuator 13 and spring 14 can play the cushioning's effect, improve the holistic stability of device.

Embodiment 2, as shown in fig. 1 to 4, the inner surface of the rotary table 8 is connected with a threaded rod 9 through a thread, the right end face of the threaded rod 9 is fixedly connected with a rotating handle 10, the outer surface of the right side of the workbench 1 is uniformly provided with a plurality of positioning holes 11, and the inner surface of each positioning hole 11 is connected with the outer surface of the threaded rod 9 through a thread.

The effect that its whole embodiment 2 reached does, after rotating carousel 8 and adjusting the position of accomplishing sliding seat 12, it can rotate threaded rod 9 at the 8 rotations of carousel to hold the turning handle 10, rotate threaded rod 9 and insert back in locating hole 11, fixed spacing between threaded rod 9 and the workstation 1, can prevent carousel 8 to take place to rotate, the vibration of avoiding producing at the emergence centrifuge 5 during operation can lead to two-way lead screw 6 to follow resonance and rotate and lead to splint 15 to take place not hard up problem, splint 15 has been promoted to the fixed stability of centrifuge 5.

The working principle is as follows: place behind placing board 4 top with centrifuge 5, it can drive two-way lead screw 6 and rotate to hold turning handle 10 and rotate carousel 8, two-way lead screw 6 can drive two sliding seat 12 when rotating and carry out relative movement, can drive splint 15 and move centrifuge 5 position and press from both sides the tight fixed with centrifuge 5 when two sliding seat 12 move to centrifuge 5 direction, the setting of rubber pad 16 can play the guard action to centrifuge 5, at centrifuge 5 during operation, the vibration that centrifuge 5 produced can be conducted the attenuator 13 position by splint 15, cooperation work through attenuator 13 and spring 14 can play buffering absorbing effect, improve the holistic stability of device, it can rotate threaded rod 9 at carousel 8 to hold turning handle 10, after inserting threaded rod 9 rotation in locating hole 11, fixed spacing between threaded rod 9 and workstation 1, avoid the vibration that produces when taking place centrifuge 5 during operation can lead to two-way lead to screw 6 to follow resonance rotation and lead to splint 15 to take place not hard up the problem, splint 15 has promoted the fixed stability to centrifuge 5.
